lines.en: : Hmm...am I in the right place? There don’t be appear to be any customers.
: Mmph!!?! Wrclsd!!!
: Be quiet. We haven’t been caught-
: Oh, Akira. What are you doing here?
: Aghkrrra?! Isstyrnmm?!
: I work here now.
: Oh, is that so? I’d assumed your leave from teaching at Kumon-mi High would only be temporary, but perhaps I was wrong if you’ve already sought new employment.
: Yup. I’ve always wanted to be a bartender.
: Who is that?! Is that the rich lady?! What’s she doing here?! What do I do?!
: Stop asking questions you already know the answer to.
: I figured out the first answer on my own! It’s the second one I’m struggling with!
: I don’t care what you do, just stop making noise.
: Are you...talking to yourself?
: Life has been hard. I’m experiencing daily mental lapses due to recent traumatic events. Some of which involve talking to myself.
: Oh dear. Perhaps you should see a doctor, then? I wouldn’t mind referring you to my family’s psychologist. I actually have a meeting with her and that Yasu girl next week.
: If you’re okay with it, I could put in a good word for-
: Nope. I have a therapist already.
: You do? Who is it?
: I believe that’s confidential, Tsubasa.
: I was under the impression that was merely on the doctor’s behalf?
: Normally, yes. But mine is-
: Ahmf~
: ...Great at his job. And not accepting new patients at the moment.
Sara, instead of remaining still, goes back to sucking me off because of course she does.
Which isn’t to say I oppose it. I had a feeling this was going to happen the moment I told her to stop making noise instead of keeping her mouth shut. But hey, challenge is my middle name.
: Are you sure it’s just a mental issue? Because, I’m no medical professional, but you appear to be showing signs of physical distress as well.
: Inner battle. Hard to fight. What can I get you?
: Just a glass of wine, please.
: Ahn...ahm...mlm...
: Is there...a step I’m missing when it comes to ordering? I don’t typically patronize establishments such as this and am used to simply being given what I ask for.
: We’re all out of alcohol.
: Then, is there a dinner menu I could peruse?
: No. We’re out of everything. And also we are closed.
: Nngh! Nlgh! Mmlgh! Mmfh!
: Oh, I’m terribly sorry. I had no idea. I never would have come if I had known.
: It’s fine. Guess that means you’ll be leaving now, though. Goodnight, Tsubasa. Thanks for stopping by.
: Now, don’t get so hasty. The bar may be closed, but that doesn’t mean you and I can’t still spend some quality time together, does it?
: It kind of does. Sorry.
: Why is that? Is there someone else working right now? Or is this more of you just being intimidated by the prospect of being alone with me?
: In my defense...you are a very intimidating woman.

: I suppose I can be. But I was hoping to be able to...turn that aspect of my personality off tonight with a quiet night at the bar as I’ve been meaning to revisit this place for what seems like aeons now.
: Tell me- are they still hosting those silly school events here? The ones where all of the girls get together to fight over you?
: They- we host a lot of things here. It’s a good way to...drive sales.
: Mm...mnngh.....mmm~!
: As a man, though — do you not mind being treated as a...prize of sorts? Especially when there are girls like Chika who are more than willing to-
: Let’s...not talk about Chika tonight.
: Have your feelings for her dwindled now that my daughter is-
: Actually, let’s not talk about anyone. I got a job here to escape all of my...school-based relationships. If I wanted to get further involved in them, I’d just go back to teaching.
: Ahm...ahmm...aaahm~
: Ahem...So...what’s new?
: What’s new is you’re acting rather strange tonight, Akira. It’s uncommon for one to not want to talk about their...hobbies.
: No it’s not. I need to keep a level head at work or I’ll be let go.
: Oh, darling. I doubt that’s true at all. In fact, I’m hard-pressed to believe you’d be hired as anything other than eye candy to begin with as you have little to no experience in customer service.
: I was hired...to tend the bar...I am a bartender...
: Who just happens to be a handsome man in a city full of unsatisfied women. This is clearly a marketing move, Akira. And I know marketing, so you can trust me.
: I’ll admit, it’s an excellent business decision on behalf of the manager here. I can’t say I wouldn’t do the same if I had my hands in such a field.
: Mm! Mm! Mhhm!
: I suppose it’s only a matter of time, though. I- wait. Did you hear that just now?
: There aren’t any...mice in this bar, are there? I’ve heard that such creatures exist in...dirtier places. But all I know about them is their high-pitched noises and-
: Nope. No mice. No anything. Just me and you. And- ngh!
: There it is again, Akira. You should really see someone if you’re experiencing such constant, agonizing pain.
: Mhm...I’ll get right on that.
: Aaaahn....aaahn...aaahn!~
: There it is again! It sounds as if it’s coming from behind the bar. Are you sure you don’t see anything?
: Nope. Nothing at all.
: You’re hiding something from me.
: That’s impossible and you know it. You have access to an endless library of information on anyone you want and-
: I appreciate the flattery and acknowledgment of my vast network of connections and knowledge, but I’m going to have to ask you to step away from the bar, Akira. Now.
: No.
: Mlggh?!?
: No?
: Okay, I’ll tell you the truth. I don’t actually work here. I have a condition that prevents me from letting go of the counter for the rest of my life or I will immediately-
: Alright, I’ve heard enough. Step aside.
: Tsubasa, wait-
: Oh, dear God!
: Uhh...h...hey! Welcome to Sakaki-bar-a!
: Have you been...down there the entire time?
: M...Maybe?
: This is also part of my condition. Sara is simply alleviating the chronic pain brought on by-
: Akira — do you have any idea how disrespectful it is to hold a conversation with someone while having fellatio performed on you by some peasant?
: Uhh...very?
: Not really, to be honest. It’s actually a relatively common demonstration of power and status.
: Peasant?
: But still!
: I thought the door was locked, okay? You would have been suspicious if Sara just popped out from behind the counter while you were looking at me.
: You could have simply said she was restocking items or something of the like!
: Oh, shit. You’re right. I guess I just didn’t think of that.
: Well, let this be a lesson for next time then. Not all customers would be as...forgiving as I am.
Sorry, Haruka.
: I guess...we’ve all learned a valuable lesson today, then! No more blowjobs behind the bar!
: Well, surely you’re not just going to leave him like that, are you?
: Uhh...what?
: Go on. Pick up where you left off. Leaving a job like this incomplete is unbecoming in numerous ways. Which isn’t even mentioning the negative effects it could have on his health.
: You want me to...keep going?
: For his sake, of course. Not mine.
: And...you’re just going to...stand there and watch?
: Well...we just happen to be in the same place, so...I suppose it wouldn’t hurt.
: I would appreciate a glass of wine, though. If you’re not truly sold out, that is.
: C...Coming right up?...
: ...and so I say to the gardener, “Not the macrophyllas, the sargentianas!” I swear, good help is so hard to come across these days.
: Whssasrgntna???
: Oh, apologies. It’s a strain of hydrangeaceae native to China, while macrophylla is native to Japan. I always forgot I’m supposed to explain my jokes to people like you.
: Ppllkme?
: Would it kill you to not look down on “peasants” directly to their faces, Tsubasa?
: Why, I wouldn’t be able to see her if I didn’t do that. How would I be able to tell that she’s doing a good job?
: Would my word not suffice?
: Of course not, darling. Actions speak louder than words ever can. And from what I’ve seen, she’s yet to...finish the job even once. Perhaps I should direct her?
: You’re doing fine, Sara. Keep it up.
: Shsrghtyknow...Yrllyhvntcmyet...Hwcm?? Dyyuntacshlklylkoldrgrls??
: The only reason I haven’t finished yet is because Tsubasa scares me.
: I already told you, Akira — I don’t want to be intimidating tonight. There’s a time and a place for that and- well. Actually...now would be a good time for that.
: But I can be nice too! Look, I’ll even pet her.
: Mm! Thnkyou rchldy!
: You’re actually enjoying this, Sara?
: Mhm! Cminmymth!
: Good girl!
: See? If she’s not intimidated, why should you be? Just do your job and let it all out, Akira. You wouldn’t want all of her hard work to go to waste, would you?
: Mmh! Mmngh! Mlmh!
: Deeper.
: Mmh! Mmnglkl!
: Yes...just like that. I bet he loves it when you push past your limits. Don’t you, Akira?
Tsubasa tenderly runs her fingers through Sara’s hair, gently pushing her forward and adding another inch or two of my cock into her mouth.
: Don’t you, Akira?...
Okay. I was planning on narrating more, but Tsubasa seems to want my attention.
: I...do...yeah...
: Mm...how nice it must be to...feel one another in such a way. I’m sooo...jealous.
: Mm! Mmhm....mlmlm....[saramaster]...
: Is this a cabernet sauvignon or a petite sirah? Perhaps a...cabernet franc? I can’t quite tell by the color, and the taste is barely palatable so I’m not sure the vintner would know either.
: Perhaps it’s just a bad batch? Surely even you people wouldn’t stand for something of this quality, would you?
: Mm! Mmlgh! Cmfrme...cmfrme!
: I believe she would like you to ejaculate now, Akira.
: Wow, what gave you that idea?
: Ooh, how saucy of you. Does having your cock down the throat of a beautiful woman restore the confidence you lack every other minute of every day?
: Does talking down on her while she’s sucking me off turn you on?
: Would I have stuck around and watched if it didn’t?
: Why not get on the ground and help her then?
: Mm?
: And risk dirtying my stockings? I’m afraid I’ll have to pass.
: Guess being married isn’t the barrier I thought it was if that’s the first thing you can come up with.
: Saucy again. I could make a habit of this. How generous of you to provide me with so many opportunities to do just that.
: Mm?...Whsstsppsdtmnn?
: Nothing, dear. Now be a good little girl and focus, okay? You want your reward, don’t you? You want this big, strong man to cum in your little mouth?
: Mm! Mmhm! Mmm!~
: Yes, darling...
: Just.....like.....that......
: Mm! Mm! Mm! [saramaster]! Mmm!
Sara works harder at the behest of Tsubasa, and Tsubasa goes right back to petting Sara on the head like she’s some sort of domesticated animal.
And I’m sure that to a certain extent, she is. It’s probably easy to see everyone as playthings when the world is your sandbox.
But just because you own the playground doesn’t mean you won’t get jealous if someone who doesn’t starts playing with your toys.
: Cum.
: I get that it’s probably been a while for you, but that’s not really how it works.
: Well, make it work. Because for every minute you take from here on out, I’ll reveal one of your deepest...darkest secrets...
: Mm! Mm! Mmmmmh!
: Tsubasa...
: Akira...
: Mmnghrlrlr?!?!
: Ah! Excellent work. He just needed to be threatened first.
: Paah...whew...my jaw hurts.
: That...threatening thing was just a coincidence.
: The most wonderful things normally are, Akira...
: What do you-
: Sorry, Sara was it? Could you point me in the direction of the wine cellar? I’d like to take a look around while the two of you...clean up.
: Uhh...well, it’s not really a cellar. It’s kind of just a basement. And there are a lot of spiders down there right now, so-
: Ah. That explains everything.
: No worries, then. I’ll just wait on the couch. Could I offer the two of you a ride home once you’re done? My driver should still be waiting outside.
: Oh, I actually live here. My apartment’s upstairs, so I don’t need a ride.
: Ahh. That explains even more. Akira?
: I’m good, Tsubasa.
: No, no. I insist. Please, allow me to give you a ride. It’s the least I can do in exchange for the show you two put on tonight.
: Come back next week for more of the same thing! Just lock the door behind you next time.
: No, what? Tsubasa-
: I insist.
: Just go, I can clean up here. It’s getting late anyway.
: But-
: Go! And try to get her to invest in the bar while you’re at it!
: Ah- you two are whispering again.
: It better not be about me...
